detail.title: 8 Channels Penta-brid 1080N/720p Cooper 1U 1SSD 512G WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR1B08-I(512G) 8 Channels Penta-brid 1080N/720p Cooper 1U 1SSD 512G WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • Preinstall 512GB SSD • 8-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 1080N/720p@15fps Encoding Capability • Max. 10-ch IP Video Input (Up to 6MP) • AI Functions: 8-ch SMD, 8-ch AI Coding Sales Enquiry Datasheet

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 4-channel: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 10 channels of IPC access. 2 IP channels by default + 8 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 40 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 40 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 40 Mbps *After IP channels are added beyond the existing channels, the AI Function (SMD) will be disabled.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Main Stream: 8-channel: the 1st channel 1080N/720p@(1 fps–25/30 fps), others 1080N/720p@(1 fps–15 fps); 960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 8-channel: CIF@(1 fps–7 fps)
Audio and Video.Video Frame Rate: PAL: 1 fps/s–25 fps/s NTSC: 1 fps/s–30 fps/s
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: ONVIF; Panasonic; Sony; Axis; Arecont; Samsung

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4/IPv6; Wi-Fi; 3G/4G; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; P2P; UPnP; IP Filter;FTP; Alarm Server; IP Search (Supports Dahua IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 22.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback, general playback, event playback, tag playback, smart playback (motion detection)

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); IPC external alarm output; voice prompt; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Two-way Talk: Yes (share the same audio input with the first channel)
Ports.HDD Interface: 1 SSD: 512 GB (replaceable with 256 GB or 1 TB) Stores for 11 days under default settings.

General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
